title: Autopilot client config
description: Tells the CLI on your machine which host and which GitHub App to use. Lives at ~/.config/autopilot/config.json.

host.description: SSH target of the host, or "local" when this machine is the host.

slug.description: GitHub App slug, as in github.com/apps/<slug>.

owner.description: Your GitHub login. The first host setup makes it the only owner.
